title: Giving someone a rough reception
explanation: The ordinary words suggest grades of quality, but together they can describe harsh treatment. In the dictionary’s example, the speaker sends someone away after giving them blows and abuse. The expression conveys that rough reception; reading the words as praise would miss the point. The source records the usage, not a recommendation to treat anyone this way.
meaning_odia: ଅଲଗା ଅଲଗା ଭାବେ ‘ଉତ୍ତମ’ ଓ ‘ମଧ୍ୟମ’ ଗୁଣର ମାନ ବୁଝାଏ। କିନ୍ତୁ ଏଠାରେ କାହାକୁ ‘ଉତ୍ତମ ମଧ୍ୟମ ଦେବା’ ପ୍ରଶଂସା କରିବା ନୁହେଁ। ଅଭିଧାନର ଉଦାହରଣରେ ଏହା ମାଡ଼ ଓ ଗାଳି ଦେଇ ବିଦା କରିବା ଅର୍ଥରେ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ। ଏହା କଥାର ଅର୍ଥ ବୁଝାଏ; ସେଭଳି ବ୍ୟବହାରକୁ ସମର୍ଥନ କରେ ନାହିଁ।
usage_example: In a fictional account of a quarrel, a neighbour says that a visitor was given “uttama madhyama” before being sent away. The phrase signals a rough encounter, not a warm welcome. This is an original illustrative situation, not a collected account.
